arg.name: only_first_rosbag
arg.description: If true, replay only the first rosbag in the dataset. If false, replay everything.

arg.name: odom_rosbag
arg.description: Path to the rosbag containing odometry, to resolve the LiDAR poses and undistort the pointclouds. Required -- this port has no live FastLIO2 odometry.

arg.name: first_rosbag
arg.description: Path to the first rosbag of the dataset. If only_first_rosbag:=true, only this bag will be processed.

arg.name: param_file
arg.description: Name of the file from which to read wavemap's server params.

arg.name: use_batch_mode
arg.description: Whether to process the rosbag in batch mode or replay the rosbag. Batch mode requires a rosbag with pre-processed odometry.
